method: Each general-tool ID was injected into the first inventory slot at WRAM 7E:0B5A and opened through the 道具 menu in a copied gameplay state using Snes9x. The exact rendered bottom-panel label was cropped from each screenshot at x=24..232, y=168..216 and enlarged 3x with nearest-neighbor scaling. Identical render hashes preserve separately captured IDs with matching displayed labels.
captureType: per-item rendered Thai label crop; Unicode transcription intentionally omitted
availabilityNote: A rendered label proves the Thai V1.2 display string for the injected ID; it does not prove normal in-game availability, quest acquisition, or use effects.
